description: This PHP file defines the `Zone` class within the Opencart e-commerce platform's admin controller for localisation management. It handles CRUD operations, listing, and status toggling for geographic zones, including filtering, pagination, and rendering views.

classes.name: Zone
classes.description: Controller class managing localisation zones in the Opencart admin interface. Handles listing, creation, editing, status toggling, and deletion of zones, integrating with models and views.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point, loads required language, prepares breadcrumb navigation, and renders the zone list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the zone list view, primarily called via AJAX.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns data for the zone list, including filtering, sorting, pagination, and fetching related data such as languages and stores.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares data for the zone creation/edit form, loading existing zone info if applicable, and renders the form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of zone data, including validation, creating new zones, or updating existing ones. Returns JSON response.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables selected zones by setting their status to active. Returns JSON response.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables selected zones by setting their status to inactive. Returns JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected zones after validation and checks for dependencies such as linked stores or addresses. Returns JSON response.
